trigger_examples.example: 'Can I get a quote for body contouring?'

bot_question_flow.question: Are you looking to address your face, body, or both?
options: Not sure — I'd love a consultation
bot_question_flow.why: SPA 312 should not collect technical quote details publicly. This single question routes the lead to the right consultation path.

bot_question_flow.question: Only ask if they already mentioned a treatment: Are you interested in Botox, fillers, facials, laser hair removal, skin tightening, or body contouring?
bot_question_flow.why: Optional routing detail. Do not ask by default; Q1 is enough to alert the human.

bot_question_flow.question: Only ask if they mention a wedding, quinceañera, trip, photoshoot, or event: Do you have a specific date you're preparing for?
bot_question_flow.why: Date matters for brides, quinces, events, and treatment timing. Skip for normal inquiries.

bot_question_flow.question: Would you prefer to continue by DM, call/text, or through the website?
bot_question_flow.why: Optional handoff question. The conversion happens in the free consultation, not in a public quote thread.

bot_reply_templates.label: Standard consultation request
bot_reply_templates.trigger: They ask for price, quote, estimate, packages, or how much
bot_reply_templates.comment: Happy to help ✨ Pricing depends on your goals and the right treatment plan, so we start with a FREE consultation at SPA 312 Chicago. Quick question — are you thinking face, body, or both?
notes: Explains why pricing depends on consultation
Keeps the tone warm and non-clinical

bot_reply_templates.label: When they just say 'how much?' with no context
bot_reply_templates.comment: It depends on the treatment and your goals ✨ We offer a FREE consultation first — are you looking for face, body, or both?
notes: Works for Botox/fillers/facials/laser/body contouring when context is missing
Use Spanish equivalent if prospect wrote in Spanish

bot_reply_templates.label: When they signal an event or deadline
bot_reply_templates.trigger: Reply contains wedding, quinceañera, event, photoshoot, trip, ASAP, today, tomorrow, urgent
bot_reply_templates.comment: We can help you plan around your date ✨ What event are you preparing for, and are you focused on face, body, or both? We can start with a FREE consultation at SPA 312 Chicago.
notes: Uses event timeline only when relevant
Good for brides, quinces, trips, photoshoots, and last-minute beauty prep
Human should confirm treatment safety/timing privately
